description: Historical funding-rate payments for one Hyperliquid perp — timestamped funding rate and premium at each funding interval (hourly on Hyperliquid), from Hyperliquid's public info API ({"type":"fundingHistory"}). Use this to see how funding has trended (e.g. persistently positive BTC funding = longs paying shorts = crowded long), or to reconstruct realized funding cost over a window. For the CURRENT funding rate only, hyperliquid_asset_context is cheaper (one call, no window math).

end_time.description: Window END — same formats as start_time. Defaults to now.

lookback_hours.description: Window length ending now, in hours (default 24, funding pays hourly so this returns ~1 row/hour). Ignored when start_time is given.

start_time.description: Window START — ISO date/datetime or unix seconds/milliseconds. Use with end_time for a window that does not end now.

name: hyperliquid_funding_history
title: Hyperliquid Funding History
